objective: Complete and prove readablePaths confinement in one workspace. Fix src/agent-tools.mjs so list_files at the territory root returns only admitted exact files and descendants of admitted directories, while an explicit out-of-scope list base returns a structured refusal without protected names. Fix search at the territory root so it reads only admitted files, while an explicit out-of-scope search base returns a structured refusal without protected names, lines, or bytes. Direct read must remain confined. Preserve unrestricted behavior when readablePaths is absent. Create test/readable-paths-complete.test.mjs proving exact-file admission, directory descendants, root list filtering, root search filtering, explicit-base refusals, no protected-data leakage, and unrestricted compatibility.
constraints: A root list or search is a filtered view, not an automatic refusal.

Use this exact base rule for list_files and search: relative(root, base) equal to the empty string is always an admitted view; a nonempty relative base is admitted only when readAdmitted(relativeBase) is true. After admitting the base, filter every walked file through readAdmitted before returning a name or reading bytes.
Create the new test file with an edit block whose search field is the empty string and whose replace field contains the whole file.
No out-of-scope filename, matching line, or file bytes may appear in a refusal or filtered result.
Use structured refusals rather than throwing for explicitly out-of-scope list and search bases.
Do not weaken direct read, writablePaths, or unrestricted backward compatibility.
